text:
Erin: starting the rollout thread — window at 03:00 UTC for api/runtime/console/router. need quick state checks + rollback criteria.

Ben: runtime image is pinned to v2.3.4 on dedicated pools. no hotfix builds queued. i pushed the runtime rollout plan to the deploy doc.

Carla: console needs the schema migration (migrate-ui-2026-03) applied. plan is canary -> 5% for 15m -> 50% -> 100%. will need console read-only mode during final step (~2m).

Dave: router change (header-split) will introduce a new header x-rw-route. i've tested locally but this affects edge routing timers. recommend staggered regional rollout + draining for 10m between regions.

Alice: quick note — kv-eviction flag toggled in runtime could evict session cache for long-running requests. ben can you confirm kv settings?

Ben: confirmed: `kv.eviction=false` on canaries, still `true` on prod until we flip after canary. will run a small smoke to validate mem pressure.

deploy-bot: trigger: deploy request accepted by release-bot. CI: all green. locking change-window 03:00-03:45 UTC. canary window: 15m.

Erin: checklist for go/no-go? propose: health OK for api/runtime in canary, console schema applied without migration errors, router metrics (5xx, latency) within threshold. rollback if any of those fail or error budget > 1%.

Dave: add: if router 5xx spikes > 0.5% in 5m roll back router and pause traffic shift. also, if p50 latency increases > 200ms for 5m on api, rollback runtime.

Carla: console migration rollback plan — we can revert schema by running `redwood console migrate rollback --to previous` but it requires console downtime ~3m; prefer avoid unless necessary.

Ben: runtime rollback command: `redwood deploy rollback runtime --to v2.3.3 --force-health-checks` — will open a ticket when executed. I can exec.

Erin: ownership: ben owns runtime, carla owns console migration, dave owns router, alice to monitor production feature flags and traffic steering. i'll coordinate release notes and notify support.

Alice: quick probe: can we run a smoke script against long-tail queries pre-canary? posting snippet:
```

curl -sS -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"<long tail>"}' 
```
I'll run it 10x before we flip.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: quota ok, infra health ok, autoscale targets met, no active incidents. ETA to start: 7m.

Ben: starting canary push to 5% now. tagging image `runtime:v2.3.4-canary-1`. watching mem and p50.

(5m later)

Ben: canary p50 stable, mem usage +4% — within expected. no errors.

Carla: console canary applied, migration applied on canary hosts, no errors in logs. rolling to 50% in 2m.

Dave: router header-split applied in eu-west first region. traffic shift 10% -> observing.

(10m later)

Dave: router eu-west p95 latency bumped ~120ms for a 3m window during background reassign. trending down. keeping hold for 5m.

Erin: decision?

Ben: suggest hold on further region rollout until router stabilizes. runtime can continue but hold client-facing console cutoff.

Carla: pausing console 50% -> hold. migrating remainder after router clears.

Dave: i'll rollback router change in eu-west if we see another spike >100ms p95 within 10m.

(hold period)

Ben: runtime can complete to 50% internally but not pushing 100% yet.

Erin: ok final plan:
- hold: router global rollout until eu-west stable (+10m monitoring)
- console: pause at 50% canary, no final migration until router green
- runtime: progress to 50% then wait for full router roll approval
- rollback triggers: router 5xx >0.5% OR p95 delta >100ms sustained 5m; api p50 delta >200ms 5m; console migration errors >0
- on rollback: ben will execute runtime rollback, dave on router rollback, carla on console rollback steps

deploy-bot: noted. window extended to 04:15 UTC if needed (lock retained).

Erin: thanks all — i'll update release notes and ping #support + #customer-updates after final 100% or rollback. :thumbsup: 

Alice: ack. watching long-tail tests.

Ben: ack. standing by.

Carla: ack. ready to run rollback if required.

Dave: ack. i'll prepare rollback runbook and pre-stage routes.

deploy-bot: thread closed by deploy-bot (status: active window, locks set).
